app.name: Melee for the Wii
app.short_description: Super Smash Bros. Melee, native, with Slippi Online
app.long_description:
The decompiled Super Smash Bros. Melee (NTSC 1.02) running natively on the Wii, from your own disc image on the SD card or a USB drive. With Slippi Online (Direct and Unranked) over Wi-Fi or a USB LAN adapter, replays, Slippi Launcher's console mirroring, Slippi's offline codes and your own cheats.
Unofficial and open source. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo or Project Slippi. Needs your own NTSC 1.02 Melee disc image.
